ucs.title: [LLM] Turla / Secret Blizzard — Cloud webmail & storage C2 from non-browser process (ComRAT v4 / PowerStallion / Crutch)
ucs.description: Hunts non-browser/non-mail-client processes (PowerShell, wscript, rundll32, binaries living in %Temp%/%ProgramData%) reaching out to Gmail, OneDrive, Microsoft Graph, Dropbox, or Yandex Mail. Turla (VENOMOUS BEAR / Secret Blizzard / Snake) is the only major Russian APT that has repeatedly built backdoors on top of legitimate cloud mail and storage services: ComRAT v4 reads commands from a Gmail inbox, PowerStallion uses a OneDrive folder as a dead-drop, and Crutch v3+ exfils to Dropbox via the official API.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.url) as urls values(Web.http_user_agent) as user_agents values(Web.src) as src from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.dest IN ("mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","drive.google.com","docs.google.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com","api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","mail.yandex.com","mail.ru","yandex.ru") by Web.src Web.user Web.dest Web.app | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | where NOT match(user_agents, "(?i)(chrome|edg(e|a)|firefox|safari|outlook|onedrive|microsoftteams|thunderbird|brave|opera|trident|msie|gecko)") | where count>=3 | join type=left src [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Processes.process_name) as proc values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes by Processes.dest | rename Processes.dest as src | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`] | sort - count | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let _legit_cloud_clients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","msteams.exe","teams.exe","ms-teams.exe","onenote.exe","skype.exe"]);
let _turla_c2_hosts = dynamic(["mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","drive.google.com","docs.google.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com","outlook.office.com","outlook.office365.com","dropbox.com","api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","mail.yandex.com","mail.ru","yandex.ru"]);
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (_turla_c2_hosts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (_legit_cloud_clients)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName has_any ("powershell","pwsh","wscript","cscript","rundll32","regsvr32","mshta","certutil","bitsadmin","msbuild","installutil","python","wmiprvse","cmd","curl","wget")
    or InitiatingProcessFolderPath matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp)\\"
| summarize ConnCount = count(),
            DistinctMinutes = dcount(bin(Timestamp, 1m)),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            SampleUrl = any(RemoteUrl),
            DistinctHosts = make_set(RemoteUrl, 25)
    by DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
       InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessSHA256
| where ConnCount >= 3 and DistinctMinutes >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let _legit_cloud_clients = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","iexplore.exe","outlook.exe","thunderbird.exe","onedrive.exe","onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe","msteams.exe","teams.exe","ms-teams.exe","onenote.exe"]);
let _turla_c2_hosts = dynamic(["mail.google.com","accounts.google.com","drive.google.com","docs.google.com","onedrive.live.com","api.onedrive.com","graph.microsoft.com","outlook.office.com","outlook.office365.com","dropbox.com","api.dropboxapi.com","content.dropboxapi.com","mail.yandex.com","mail.ru","yandex.ru"]);
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| extend Host = tolower(coalesce(HttpHostName, DstHostname, ""))
| where Host has_any (_turla_c2_hosts)
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, @"\")[-1]))
| where ProcName !in (_legit_cloud_clients)
| where ProcName has_any ("powershell","pwsh","wscript","cscript","rundll32","regsvr32","mshta","certutil","bitsadmin","msbuild","installutil","python","wmiprvse","cmd","curl","wget")
    or ActingProcessName matches regex @"(?i)\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp)\\"
| summarize ConnCount = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Hosts = make_set(Host, 25), SampleCmd = any(ActingProcessCommandLine)
    by DvcHostname, SrcUsername, ProcName
| where ConnCount >= 3
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla / Secret Blizzard - Cloud Mail or Storage C2 from Non-Browser Process
id: a7b2c3d4-e5f6-4a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser / non-mail-client processes connecting to legitimate cloud webmail and storage services that Turla repeatedly weaponises as bidirectional C2 channels (ComRAT v4 -> Gmail, PowerStallion -> OneDrive, Crutch -> Dropbox).
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2020/05/26/agentbtz-comratv4-ten-year-journey/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2019/05/29/turla-powerstallion-microsoft-onedrive/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2020/12/02/turla-crutch-back-door/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.t1071.003
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1567.002
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_dst:
    DestinationHostname:
      - 'mail.google.com'
      - 'accounts.google.com'
      - 'drive.google.com'
      - 'docs.google.com'
      - 'onedrive.live.com'
      - 'api.onedrive.com'
      - 'graph.microsoft.com'
      - 'api.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'content.dropboxapi.com'
      - 'mail.yandex.com'
      - 'mail.ru'
      - 'yandex.ru'
  filter_legit_clients:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\brave.exe'
      - '\opera.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\thunderbird.exe'
      - '\onedrive.exe'
      - '\onedrivestandaloneupdater.exe'
      - '\teams.exe'
      - '\ms-teams.exe'
      - '\msteams.exe'
      - '\onenote.exe'
      - '\skype.exe'
  condition: selection_dst and not filter_legit_clients
falsepositives:
  - Custom Python or PowerShell automation legitimately pulling from Google Drive / OneDrive / Graph
  - Backup tooling using Dropbox API
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:(3 OR 22) (@DestinationHostname:(mail.google.com OR accounts.google.com OR drive.google.com OR docs.google.com OR onedrive.live.com OR api.onedrive.com OR graph.microsoft.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR content.dropboxapi.com OR mail.yandex.com OR mail.ru OR yandex.ru) OR @QueryName:(mail.google.com OR drive.google.com OR onedrive.live.com OR api.dropboxapi.com OR graph.microsoft.com OR mail.yandex.com OR mail.ru)) -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\MsEdge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\Firefox.exe OR *\brave.exe OR *\outlook.exe OR *\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\Outlook.exe OR *\onedrive.exe OR *\OneDrive.exe OR *\teams.exe OR *\Teams.exe OR *\ms-teams.exe OR *\thunderbird.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\onenote.exe OR *\OneNote.exe OR *\skype.exe) AND (@Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\CScript.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\RegSvr32.exe OR *\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\certutil.exe OR *\CertUtil.exe OR *\bitsadmin.exe OR *\python.exe OR *\Python.exe OR *\curl.exe OR *\wget.exe OR *\wmiprvse.exe) OR @Image:(*\AppData\Local\Temp\* OR *\AppData\Roaming\* OR *\ProgramData\* OR *\PerfLogs\* OR *\Users\Public\* OR *\Windows\Temp\*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/^(mail\.google\.com|accounts\.google\.com|drive\.google\.com|docs\.google\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|api\.onedrive\.com|graph\.microsoft\.com|api\.dropboxapi\.com|content\.dropboxapi\.com|mail\.yandex\.com|mail\.ru|yandex\.ru)$/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|brave|iexplore|outlook|onedrive|onedrivestandaloneupdater|teams|ms-teams|msteams|thunderbird|onenote|skype|opera)\.exe$/i
| ContextImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wscript|cscript|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|certutil|bitsadmin|msbuild|installutil|python|wmiprvse|cmd|curl|wget)\.exe$/i OR ContextImageFileName=/\\(AppData\\Local\\Temp|AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData|PerfLogs|Users\\Public|Windows\\Temp)\\/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function={ count(as=connections) | min(_time, as=firstSeen) | max(_time, as=lastSeen) })
| connections >= 3
ucs.rationale: Bidirectional C2 over legitimate consumer cloud services is the signature operational tradecraft of Turla's modern toolkit. ComRAT v4 polls a Gmail inbox via the HTML web UI, PowerStallion polls a OneDrive folder, and Crutch v3+ uses the Dropbox API — all three were publicly documented by ESET/Kaspersky and are unique to this actor at this scale. ucs.title: [LLM] Turla / Secret Blizzard — WMI permanent event subscription with PowerShell/script consumer (Carbon / Kazuar / ComRAT installer pattern)
ucs.description: Detects creation of WMI permanent event subscriptions (FilterToConsumerBinding with CommandLineEventConsumer or ActiveScriptEventConsumer) whose action payload is an encoded PowerShell or scripting-host command. Turla has repeatedly used WMI event subscriptions for fileless persistence and trigger-driven execution across the Carbon framework, Kazuar .NET backdoor, and several ComRAT installers — distinguishing them from APT crews that prefer Run keys or scheduled tasks alone.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","mofcomp.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Register-WmiEvent*" OR Processes.process="*Set-WmiInstance*" OR Processes.process="*__EventFilter*" OR Processes.process="*__EventConsumer*" OR Processes.process="*CommandLineEventConsumer*" OR Processes.process="*ActiveScriptEventConsumer*" OR Processes.process="*FilterToConsumerBinding*" OR Processes.process="*New-CimSubscription*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | where match(cmdline, "(?i)(CommandLineEventConsumer|ActiveScriptEventConsumer|FilterToConsumerBinding|Register-WmiEvent|Set-WmiInstance.*__Event)") AND match(cmdline, "(?i)(powershell|-enc|-encodedcommand|FromBase64String|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|Net\.WebClient|System\.Reflection\.Assembly|rundll32|mshta|regsvr32|wscript|cscript)") | sort - count | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let _suspicious_payload = dynamic(["powershell","-enc","-encodedcommand","frombase64string","invoke-expression","downloadstring","net.webclient","system.reflection.assembly","rundll32","mshta","regsvr32","wscript.shell"]);
let _wmi_keywords = dynamic(["Register-WmiEvent","Set-WmiInstance","__EventFilter","__EventConsumer","CommandLineEventConsumer","ActiveScriptEventConsumer","FilterToConsumerBinding","New-CimSubscription"]);
let WmiSubscribers =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","mofcomp.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (_wmi_keywords)
    | where tolower(ProcessCommandLine) has_any (_suspicious_payload)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
              ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let WmiNativeEvents =
    DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ActionType in ("WmiBindEventFilterToConsumer","WmiCreateEventConsumer","WmiCreateEventFilter")
    | extend AF = parse_json(AdditionalFields)
    | extend ConsumerType = tostring(AF.ConsumerType),
             CommandLineTemplate = tostring(AF.CommandLineTemplate),
             ScriptText = tostring(AF.ScriptText),
             ConsumerName = tostring(AF.ConsumerName)
    | where ConsumerType in~ ("CommandLineEventConsumer","ActiveScriptEventConsumer")
        or isnotempty(CommandLineTemplate) or isnotempty(ScriptText)
    | where tolower(strcat(CommandLineTemplate, " ", ScriptText)) has_any (_suspicious_payload)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              FileName = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              ProcessCommandLine = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              InitiatingProcessCommandLine = "",
              SHA256 = InitiatingProcessSHA256;
union WmiSubscribers, WmiNativeEvents
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let _suspicious_payload = dynamic(["powershell","-enc","-encodedcommand","frombase64string","invoke-expression","downloadstring","net.webclient","system.reflection.assembly","rundll32","mshta","regsvr32","wscript.shell"]);
let _wmi_keywords = dynamic(["Register-WmiEvent","Set-WmiInstance","__EventFilter","__EventConsumer","CommandLineEventConsumer","ActiveScriptEventConsumer","FilterToConsumerBinding","New-CimSubscription"]);
let ProcEvents =
    SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where Account !endswith "$"
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","mofcomp.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any (_wmi_keywords)
    | where tolower(CommandLine) has_any (_suspicious_payload)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName;
let WmiActivity =
    WindowsEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Provider == "Microsoft-Windows-WMI-Activity"
    | where EventID in (5860, 5861)
    | extend Operation = tostring(EventData.Operation),
             PossibleCause = tostring(EventData.PossibleCause),
             User = tostring(EventData.User),
             Namespace = tostring(EventData.NamespaceName)
    | where tolower(strcat(Operation, " ", PossibleCause)) has_any (_suspicious_payload)
        or tolower(strcat(Operation, " ", PossibleCause)) has_any ("commandlineeventconsumer","activescripteventconsumer")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = User, NewProcessName = "WMI-Activity",
              CommandLine = strcat(Operation, " | ", PossibleCause), ParentProcessName = Namespace;
union ProcEvents, WmiActivity
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Turla / Secret Blizzard - WMI Permanent Event Subscription with Script Payload
id: b8c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d1e-2f3a4b5c6d7e
status: experimental
description: Detects creation of WMI permanent event subscriptions (Sysmon 19/20/21) whose consumer payload contains PowerShell, encoded commands, or other scripting-host invocation - matching the Carbon, Kazuar, and ComRAT installer persistence pattern attributed to Turla.
references:
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2017/03/30/carbon-paper-peering-turlas-second-stage-backdoor/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0010/
  - https://www.welivesecurity.com/2020/05/26/agentbtz-comratv4-ten-year-journey/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/18
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1546.003
  - attack.t1047
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.g0010
logsource:
  product: windows
  service: sysmon
detection:
  wmi_consumer_create:
    EventID: 20
    Type:
      - 'Command Line'
      - 'Active Script'
  wmi_binding:
    EventID: 21
  payload:
    Destination|contains:
      - 'powershell'
      - 'pwsh'
      - '-enc'
      - '-encodedcommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'System.Reflection.Assembly'
      - 'rundll32'
      - 'mshta'
      - 'regsvr32'
      - 'wscript.shell'
  condition: (wmi_consumer_create and payload) or wmi_binding
falsepositives:
  - SCCM / Intune client management agents
  - Legitimate monitoring tooling that registers WMI subscriptions (rare)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon (@EventID:(19 OR 20 OR 21) AND (@Type:("Command Line" OR "Active Script") OR @Destination:(*powershell* OR *PowerShell* OR *POWERSHELL* OR *pwsh* OR *-enc* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *DownloadString* OR *Net.WebClient* OR *rundll32* OR *RunDll32* OR *mshta* OR *MSHTA* OR *regsvr32*))) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\mofcomp.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\wscript.exe) @CommandLine:(*Register-WmiEvent* OR *Set-WmiInstance* OR *__EventFilter* OR *__EventConsumer* OR *CommandLineEventConsumer* OR *ActiveScriptEventConsumer* OR *FilterToConsumerBinding*) @CommandLine:(*powershell* OR *PowerShell* OR *-enc* OR *EncodedCommand* OR *FromBase64String* OR *Invoke-Expression* OR *DownloadString* OR *rundll32* OR *mshta*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh|wmic|mofcomp|cscript|wscript)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(Register-WmiEvent|Set-WmiInstance|__EventFilter|__EventConsumer|CommandLineEventConsumer|ActiveScriptEventConsumer|FilterToConsumerBinding|New-CimSubscription)/i
| CommandLine=/(powershell|-enc|-encodedcommand|FromBase64String|Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|Net\.WebClient|System\.Reflection\.Assembly|rundll32|mshta|regsvr32|WScript\.Shell)/i
| UserName!=/^(NT AUTHORITY|SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, ParentBaseFileName, UserName], function={ count(as=count) | min(_time, as=firstSeen) | max(_time, as=lastSeen) | collect([CommandLine, SHA256HashData]) })
ucs.rationale: WMI permanent event subscriptions (FilterToConsumerBinding + Command-Line or Active-Script consumer) carrying a script payload are an unusual artefact in benign environments but were a documented Turla signature across multiple Carbon, Kazuar and ComRAT installer chains (ESET 2017 Carbon white-paper, ESET 2020 ComRAT v4 report). The combination of WMI subscription verbs + scripting-host payload +
